application_credentials.description: Create an app in the [HUAWEI Developers console]({console_url}), enable HUAWEI ID and Health Kit, and add `{redirect_url}` as redirect URL. Then enter its client ID (App ID) and client secret (App secret). See the [setup guide]({docs_url}).

user.title: Data to read
user.description: Huawei only grants activity data (steps, distance, calories) to individual developer accounts. The other categories need a Huawei Developers enterprise account. A category whose scope your app was not granted is ignored.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Huawei needs you to sign in again.

abort.already_configured: This Huawei account is already configured.
abort.missing_credentials: Add the application credentials of your Huawei Developers app first.
abort.oauth_failed: Error while obtaining the access token.
abort.no_user_id: Huawei did not return a user id (the openid scope is required).
abort.wrong_account: You signed in with another Huawei account.

create_entry.default: Connected. The history is imported in the background.
